data.name: Daaim
data.gender_notes: Daaim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'd-'-m, meaning 'to tread upon, to follow a path'. A name for a determined, decisive, and firm individual. The name Daaim carries the meaning “Determined, Decisive, Firm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daaim usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, decisive, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A commitment to a higher power or purpose
data.etymology: Daaim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Determined, Decisive, Firm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daaim total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
